killerTaleLog: [day 21] Rewi: The fire settles. Rewi has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Static Kite — I put it down today." "The 3x3 scan-mark burns into the ground. The mark is the mercy — MOVE." "It descends to transmit — melee-vulnerable, +50% damage. The only window." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ruby asks "So it bleeds." Ellie says "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 21] Terry: The fire settles. Terry has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Rewi says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Raj breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 25] Ruby: The fire settles. Ruby has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ducks in a row — I put it down today." "The hissing stops. The line leans forward — it advances, and contact burns." "Every beak in the line, one coordinated bite." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Farid says "And you're still standing." Onni asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 25] Rewi: The fire settles. Rewi has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Grief Counselor — I put it down today." "It turns. On its brow, like a mask: YOUR FACE. It lowers its head. It is going to show you yourself, at speed." "You dodged — it WHEELS. A second charge, no windup, aimed at where you are NOW." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Terry says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Kuanysh says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 27] Kuanysh: The fire settles. Kuanysh has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Moderator — I put it down today." "It reviews you. 'Content noted.' A weak ranging chip while it decides." "'REMOVAL NOTICE.' Defiant or compliant — the hammer is coming down." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Onni breathes "And you're still standing." Ruby mutters "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 29] Kuanysh: The fire settles. Kuanysh has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Spool — I put it down today." "RECORD first — harmless, it watches. Then REPLAY: the reels on its back spin, and the spinning reel SHOWS what's loaded. Watch the reel, not the tape." "RECORD. The reels turn slowly, drinking in everything you do. It is learning the shape of your turns." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Caleb asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Rewi says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 29] Farid: The fire settles. Farid has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "White Noise — I put it down today." "The heron is gone. No — it's there. It was always there. You just couldn't see it until it moved." "You blink. It is somewhere else. You didn't see it move." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ruby mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Ellie breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 31] Rewi: The fire settles. Rewi has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nightlight — I put it down today." "A soft green glow under the water. Pretty. That's the problem — it's pretty." "The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ruby says quietly "And you're still standing." Onni says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 31] Raj: The fire settles. Raj has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Tick — I put it down today." "It waits. The questing legs wave — the tell." "Adjacent = attached. No dodge. It's ON you." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dmitri breathes "And you're still standing." Ellie mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 32] Sidney: The fire settles. Sidney has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Mountain Lord — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ellie mutters "We've been walking past those." Rewi says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 37] Dmitri: The fire settles. Dmitri has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Buffering — I put it down today." "Its telegraphs describe the FUTURE — 'it will step left.' Afterimages trail it; the faintest frame is the real present. You must pre-dodge — or stop predicting entirely." "It stutters backward — three seconds ago it was THERE. The afterimages collapse into one frame." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Raj asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Farid mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 37] Kuanysh: The fire settles. Kuanysh has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Focus Group — I put it down today." "The murmur rises — you can HEAR them deliberating. They're about to love your dodge and hate your strike. The ratings are honest and visible." "The lead mouth-head clears its throat — the opening question, focus-grouped and focus-grouped again: ‘So... how does that make you FEEL?’" A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ruby breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Dmitri says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 37] Dmitri: The fire settles. Dmitri has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Extended Warranty — I put it down today." "RING. RING. The sound is inside your skull. 'We have been trying to REACH you about your—'" "It dials faster. More voices. All of them want to talk about your coverage." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ruby mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Farid says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 37] Caleb: The fire settles. Caleb has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Callback — I put it down today." "It speaks — in their voice, saying things they said. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track. The wrongness is the telegraph." "It studies you — tilting their head the way they tilted theirs. It is getting better at being them." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ruby breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Rewi breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 37] Ruby: The fire settles. Ruby has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ad Break — I put it down today." "A giant floating AD glyph with a PROGRESS BAR — the bar is the telegraph. During the pause it repositions and heals, and you watch. After the bar fills, a 'skip ad' beat appears: skip faster if the audience likes you. Or look away — the ad's power is that you WATCH." "A glowing can rotates beside it — ‘THIS REGENERATION BROUGHT TO YOU BY—’ It drinks. It heals." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Rewi says "We've been walking past those." Dmitri says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 47] Raj: The fire settles. Raj has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Chorus Line — I put it down today." "The music starts — an actual audio cue, 4/4, and you can feel the downbeat coming. The downbeat is the kick. Deafness breaks the telegraph but not the beat." "The count stutters — ONE-two-THREE-and— the kick comes on the off-beat, where your dancing feet aren’t." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Sidney says quietly "And you're still standing." Onni asks "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 56] Caleb: The fire settles. Caleb has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Anaconda Empress — I put it down today." "The water bulges — a ripple with intent." "It loosens, reluctantly, and pours itself back into the water. It will remember this pool." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dmitri asks "The fire feels smaller now." Farid says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 66] Mukhwana: The fire settles. Mukhwana has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Lockpick — I put it down today." "It sits up. Its hands move too fast to follow. Something you own is suddenly in its hands." "Cornered, it shows its teeth. It fights second — but it fights." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Vasyl says quietly "So it bleeds." Caleb asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 121] Vasyl: The fire settles. Vasyl has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Herald — I put it down today." "It raises its trumpet. A line of sky goes WHITE — that's where the sound will land. MOVE." "It turns, slowly, and TWO patches of sky go white. It is showing you where NOT to stand. Split up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Regine mutters "Say that again — slower." Mara breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 127] Regine: The fire settles. Regine has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Eulogy — I put it down today." "The narration itself — it tells you what's coming, honestly, always: 'and then they ran.' The spotlight narrows as the story nears its end. It's a doom counter that gains weight each round. When the story finishes, you die — unless you've changed the narrative." "It carves while it speaks — your name, a date, a line about potential. ‘Here lies—’ The chisel is the telegraph." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Mara asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
vetKillerTaleLog: [day 52] Dmitri: The fire settles. Dmitri leans in, and the hall goes quiet in a different way — this is not a new story. "You all know The Algorithm by now. I put another one down today." "The thumbnails — it shows clickbait previews of its next move. The telegraph is literally a trailer. It rearranges the fight — your position, your available actions — toward 'engagement.' The highlighted thumbnail is the tell." "The thumbnails multiply — ‘BECAUSE YOU WATCHED: pain.’ The recommendations close in from every tile." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Farid says quietly "And you're still standing." Caleb says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light nods, slow. "We know the name. We know the hand, too."
